target.title: fix: macOS onboarding accepts logged-in Codex CLI
target.body:
Closes #102614

AI-assisted change; implementation and proof were reviewed by the submitting maintainer.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users onboarding through the macOS app would be told that a valid, logged-in Codex CLI session did not work on a fresh system. With no `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the app environment, selecting detected Codex reached the OpenAI route before its runtime plugin existed, so the real persistent Codex login was never exercised.

## Why This Change Was Made

Install the official Codex runtime plugin before the candidate's real completion test, because harness discovery needs the package on disk. Keep plugin enablement and the default model unpersisted until that completion succeeds; installation, timeout, and auth failures therefore leave no broken model selection behind.

Codex contract checked directly at `openai/codex@0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688`: the CLI accepts API-key login through stdin and persists it ([CLI dispatch](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688/codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs#L1350-L1374)); auth loading falls back to the configured persistent store when environment auth is disabled ([auth manager](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688/codex-rs/login/src/auth/manager.rs#L1215-L1285)); and app-server deliberately constructs its auth manager with API-key environment loading disabled ([app-server bootstrap](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/0d18d4f7535d93ce7fd0ffa9ca69937321352688/codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs#L477-L507)).

## User Impact

Fresh macOS installs can select an already-authenticated Codex CLI during onboarding and get a verified working OpenAI model instead of a false login failure. Failed plugin installation or failed live authentication remains non-persistent and retryable.

## Evidence

- Fresh Parallels macOS 26.5 VM, current `main` baseline: installed Codex CLI; `codex login status` passed; removed `OPENAI_API_KEY` from the app/Gateway environment; macOS onboarding detected Codex but failed with `Codex is installed, but the login didn't work.` `openclaw plugins info codex --json` reported the plugin absent.
- Focused remote test: [`pnpm test src/crestodian/setup-inference.test.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29008301636), 14/14 passed.
- Remote Blacksmith Testbox: `pnpm build` passed; `pnpm check:changed -- CHANGELOG.md src/crestodian/setup-inference.ts src/crestodian/setup-inference.test.ts` passed, including core/core-test typechecks and changed-file lint.
- Targeted format check: `pnpm format:check -- src/crestodian/setup-inference.ts src/crestodian/setup-inference.test.ts` passed.
- Fresh autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings; patch rated correct with 0.93 confidence.
- Exact-head clean-VM Codex and Claude CLI behavior proof will be added before merge.
